name: ngs-analysis-workbench
description: Journey-oriented NGS data understanding, scientific analysis design, approval-gated execution, and file-backed result interpretation.

interface.longDescription: A journey-oriented NGS workbench for FASTQ QC, bulk RNA-seq, and single-cell RNA-seq. Focused skills establish the user's starting point, design toward a scientific outcome, bind that design to live Nextflow/nf-core or Snakemake capabilities, preserve checksum-bound native approval, and interpret completed results from file-backed evidence.
defaultPrompt: run a FastQC and Salmon QC on a public RNA-seq dataset and provide an interpretation of the results.
run a scRNA-seq analysis with STARsolo on a public dataset and provide an interpretation of the results.
run a NGS analysis on my sequencing data in my project.
